_comment: Allowlist for scripts/check-config-parity.mjs (task 0064). An UNLISTED variable is
REQUIRED — that is the point of the guard, and a test asserts it. Every entry needs a
non-empty reason: an entry without one is the same rot this guard exists to prevent.
phase: 1 entries suppress a finding today; phase 2 entries are recorded but INERT and
never suppress anything, so they cannot mask a Phase 1 gap.

allow.name: WORKER_ID
allow.reason: Set per worker by the cluster master at fork time (src/server/Master.ts, cluster.fork({WORKER_ID: index})). Never a deploy input.

allow.name: HOSTNAME
allow.reason: Supplied by the container runtime; Docker sets it to the container id. Read only for OTel resource attributes (src/server/OtelResource.ts).

allow.name: MASTER_INTERNAL_ORIGIN
allow.reason: Optional override with a safe in-process default at the read site (src/server/ServerEndpoints.ts). Absent from the deploy heredoc on purpose.

allow.name: STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
allow.reason: Genuine forwarding gap, deliberately not fixed here (0064 is a guard, not a fix). DefinePlugin substitutes it for the client and the server read defaults to empty, so nothing breaks today: the RU market ships no Stripe flow. Tracked as a candidate new brief.

allow.name: YANDEX_PAYMENTS_SECRET
allow.reason: Recorded now to land task 0195's hand-off where it asked. INERT in Phase 1 and honestly so: the key is forwarded at both profile hops today, so no Phase 1 rule can fire on it. It becomes live when the Phase 2 non-empty check exists.

allow.name: FEEDBACK_TELEGRAM_TOKEN
allow.reason: Operator Telegram bot token (task 0067), optional by design (src/profile-server/Server.ts warns at startup: operator name-change notifications off, requests still work). INERT in Phase 1: forwarded at both profile hops, so no name rule can fire. Its VALUE is checked live by the on-box report in setup-profile.sh (task 0220), not by this name-only checker.

allow.name: FEEDBACK_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
allow.reason: Operator Telegram chat id (task 0067), optional by design (src/profile-server/Server.ts warns at startup: operator name-change notifications off, requests still work). INERT in Phase 1: forwarded at both profile hops, so no name rule can fire. Its VALUE is checked live by the on-box report in setup-profile.sh (task 0220), not by this name-only checker.

allow.name: TELEGRAM_PROXY_URL
allow.reason: Egress proxy for api.telegram.org (blocked from RU IPs), optional only while the token+chat pair is empty (src/profile-server/Server.ts warns at startup: operator name-change notifications off, requests still work). INERT in Phase 1: forwarded at both profile hops, so no name rule can fire. Its VALUE is checked live by the on-box report in setup-profile.sh (task 0220), not by this name-only checker.
